# Paperless Data Collection  {#sec-paperless}

## Tools & Resources

1. [EpiCollect user's guide](https://docs.epicollect.net/)

<!-- 2. Best data app for interactive voice data collection: [Magpi](https://www.magpi.com/blog/interactive-data-collection) (Web, iOS, Android) -->

1. Lists of useful apps for data collection in the field: Start with the [Bruna Lab Super-List](https://brunalab.github.io/apps_for_fieldwork/) _(if you want to suggest any additions to the list please do so [here](https://github.com/BrunaLab/apps_for_fieldwork/issues))_. You can also check [[list 2]](https://www.teamscopeapp.com/mobile-data-collection-guide/7-mobile-data-collection-apps-for-field-research), [[list 3]](https://www.researchgate.net/post/Please-could-you-indicate-some-useful-android-apps-for-Ecology-Forestry-or-Environment), [[list 4]](https://writingfornature.wordpress.com/2012/08/17/tools-for-the-modern-primate-apps-for-field-work/), [[list 5]](https://ayrnstories.wordpress.com/2017/08/09/apps-in-ecological-research/), [[list 6]](https://www.commonsense.org/education/top-picks/excellent-ecology-and-environmental-science-apps-games-and-websites), and [[list 7]](https://www.researchgate.net/post/What_essential_android_apps_should_a_field_biologist_know_about)

1. Paid platforms for paperless data collection

* [Fulcrum](https://www.fulcrumapp.com/); [link to post](https://gadgets360.com/science/features/fulcrum-app-science-fieldwork-data-collection-2294662) describing how it was used by an NGO.
* [ODK](https://getodk.org)
